project.name: Bunya-Jido
project.summary: Validated task routes for changes to grounded semantic publication.

task_routes.intent: Modify provider/API hint discovery or Studio overlay provenance without promoting generated example text as architecture.
contracts: Provider hints from generated prompts, schemas, or viewer templates must not become Studio overlay landmarks.
watch_out: Suppress generated example hints without discarding source or configuration provenance.

task_routes.intent: Modify publication blockers or grounding metrics while preserving the trust contract.
contracts: Core node and critical edge evidence must remain inspectable before semantic publication.
watch_out: A weakened blocker changes whether output is allowed to claim Grounded status.

task_routes.intent: Modify deterministic Studio readability or scenario-quality diagnostics without presenting subjective editorial judgment as proof.
contracts: Deterministic blockers and warnings must remain separate from review-required editorial judgments.
watch_out: A heuristic warning must not silently become a publication claim about the best explanation.

task_routes.intent: Adjust cross-domain rubric fixtures while preserving domain-neutral authoring.
contracts: Benchmark fixtures must demonstrate differing repository shapes without turning an external reference atlas into a prompt seed.
watch_out: An independently reviewed complex workflow may test output quality, but its nouns must not become generic viewer or prompt vocabulary.

task_routes.intent: Adjust agent-map validation, conservative context decision routing, evidence-backed route recovery, bounded discovery, or task-route paths shown in rendered maps.
when_to_use: context decision output or trusted route matching behavior
common_failure_modes: Selecting a route from one broad shared-workflow term.
Leaving an in-scope repair without a trusted route or bounded discovery.
Exposing safe-edit paths from a non-MATCH decision.
contracts: Only routes validated against repository-relative inputs may reach trusted context or HTML paths.
Non-MATCH task-selection decisions must not expose trusted routes or safe-edit paths.
IN_SCOPE_NO_ROUTE discovery candidates must be capped, repository-relative, evidence-backed, and read-only.
A common failure mode or shared-workflow term cannot confirm a route without independent positive evidence.
watch_out: Context output and viewer path presets must continue to share the same validated routes.

task_routes.intent: Improve how grounded status, evidence, semantic paths, authored alternate views, or narrated walkthroughs are presented offline.
when_to_use: offline HTML viewer navigation, orientation, accessibility, or responsive presentation
when_not_to_use: CLI-only context routing without viewer changes
contracts: The viewer must display published trust information without becoming the evidence source.
Human-facing orientation and inspector details must come from published graph data without reinterpreting authored claims.
The canvas-first visual design must retain a keyboard-accessible repository outline and readable narrow-screen controls.
Studio projection labels and contextual reveal must come from validated atlas data, with classic v1 behavior preserved.
Studio scenario playback must display its authored basis, avoid implying runtime order for structural tours, and restore the prior view on exit.
Studio layout must follow authored plane and projection data rather than privileged domain plane names.
watch_out: A visual change must keep the offline standalone artifact readable and truthful.
A narrated tour must not turn illustrative structure into a claim of recorded behavior.
